metric_rules.precision_at_5: Unique relevant returned source:section keys / 5, absent slots count as misses.
metric_rules.recall_at_5: Unique relevant returned keys / all proposed relevant keys; excluded sources remain visible misses.
metric_rules.mrr: Reciprocal rank of first proposed relevant key; macro mean over the stated question population.
metric_rules.coverage: Syntactic locator/hash integrity is separate from human-reviewed claim support.
metric_rules.applicability: Technical scope/date/authority predicates are separate from human legal applicability.
metric_rules.abstention: Measure full/partial/missing candidate coverage separately from approved-only runtime withholding.
metric_rules.groups: Overlapping tags; never sum group sizes or average control outcomes into relevance scores.
metric_rules.independence: No independently adjudicated metric until real reviewer identities, labels and adjudication exist.
